audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer called Akshan an 'AD melee-range duelist with no real poke' with 'short auto-range'. He is a ranged champion whose Avengerang (Q) pokes at 850 and returns, and the difficulty comes from Heroic Swing needing terrain to anchor — not from his auto range.
audit.why: Akshan kit: Q range 850, damage going out and coming back; E range 800, 'fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it'.
audit.corrected: You out-range him, but only just: reset outside 850 and stand away from walls he can hook.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[].side read 'Akshan' while content win[] and packet.levelChart read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei. Spike text also invented 'Heroic Swing (E) charges' — the ability has no charges.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches win[0..6]; Akshan E is a single 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s cast.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-3 Hwei, 4-5 and 6 skill (Comeuppance at 100s), first item and 2+ items Hwei.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions were missing. Comeuppance is NOT a global execute — it is 2500 range, deals damage based on missing health, and stops on the first champion, MINION or structure hit, so a minion body blocks it. Going Rogue is camouflage and Hwei has no reveal in kit. Dirty Fighting shields him on every third hit against a champion, eating your burst window.
audit.why: Akshan kit R text ('first champion, minion, or structure hit', 'damage based on missing health', range 2500); W stealth flag; P text 'grants him a Shield if the target was a champion'.
audit.corrected: Keep a minion in the line to Comeuppance, buy a Control Ward and sweeper for Going Rogue, and force the third-hit shield before committing.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and packet flagged zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries all three numbers plus the collision rule; sequencing added to dosFull[1].d and wants.you[1].

notes: Two substantive factual corrections. (1) The content layer described Akshan as an 'AD melee-range duelist with no real poke' with 'short auto-range' — he is ranged, Avengerang is 850 and hits twice. (2) Comeuppance was called a 'global execute' in four places; Riot's text says 2500 range, damage based on MISSING HEALTH, and it hits 'the first champion, minion, or structure' — a minion body stops it outright, which is the single most useful line in this matchup and was nowhere on the page. Also killed an invented mechanic: 'Heroic Swing (E) charges' — the ability has no charges, it is one 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s cast that must anchor to terrain and is interrupted by champion collision. Level chart: all seven full-layer sides read 'Akshan' against content win[] and packet.levelChart reading Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei; I moved the full layer onto the already-correct content layer, so no paired win[N] edit was needed. Ratings left untouched (direction of the scale still unresolved). Both _missing interactions landed: Going Rogue camouflage vs Hwei's zero reveal (breakdown.mid, wants.you[2]) and the Dirty Fighting third-hit shield (dontsFull[2].d).
